_about: Content of the slides withdrawn from the image kit on 2026-10-14 at Imran's instruction (no slide snapshots in a proposal; their content may be used as text). Transcribed by the main session: the first three from the withdrawn slide images, the rest from the text of IV's corporate deck (Inspirit Vision - Corporate Deck.pptx, case-study slides 24-33), 2026-10-14. Show the case studies whose vendor is proposed for the deal. Case studies are anonymised exactly as IV's own case-study deck describes them: never add a client name. Analyst positions carry the date the slide states; do not restate one without it, and do not claim any ranking not listed here.
